title: Module adjunction unit isomorphism for an isomorphic scheme map
statement: For an isomorphism of schemes, the underlying additive sheaf map of the canonical module adjunction unit is an isomorphism.

proof.text: The inverse-image functor on pro-etale sheaves is an equivalence for an isomorphic scheme map. Transport this equivalence through the coefficient-ring comparison and reflect the unit along the underlying sheaf functor.

lean.statement: theorem frobeniusIntegralRootTransport_moduleUnit_isIso (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map ((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction g (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y) (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull g)).unit.app (purTwistIntegralModule Y l E)))
